definitions.aerial.headers (+ _shot/_clear/_pass): Outfielder with z > 0.14 m whose recent_kick_ticks rose versus the previous tick (a new contact); split by recent_kick_kind: 4/5 shot, 3 clearance/lob, else pass/flick.
definitions.aerial.jumps_outfield / aerial.jumps_gk: Count of z going from <= 0 to > 0 between consecutive open-play ticks (outfielders / GK; GK dives that leave the ground count).
definitions.aerial.max_airborne_outfield: Max number of the side's outfielders with z > 0 on one open-play tick.
definitions.collision.<class>.depth_mean_m / depth_m: Overlap depth 0.8 m - centre distance over all overlapping pair-ticks of the class: mean, and maximum over the match.
definitions.collision.<class>.events_per_min: Overlap episodes per open-play minute: a pair's maximal run of consecutive open-play ticks below 0.8 m counts once (runs are cut when open play stops).
definitions.collision.<class>.stuck_pairs / stuck_me: Stuck pair = overlap episode lasting more than 10 consecutive open-play ticks (no relative-speed condition). Count per match and mean episode length in ticks (60 ticks = 1 s; 0 when there are none).
definitions.collision.<class>.ticks_gt1cm_per_min: Open-play ticks with at least one pair of the class overlapping by more than 1 cm (centre distance < 0.79 m), per open-play minute. The state is sampled after the sim's separation pass, which leaves resolved pairs at 0.8 m minus fixed-point rounding (resting contact); this variant counts only residual penetration the pass did not resolve.
definitions.collision.<class>.ticks_per_min: Round 3. Pair classes: any (every on-pitch pair, both teams, GKs included), teammate (pairs of this side's players only), opponent (home-away pairs). An overlap is a pair whose centres are closer than 0.8 m (the sim's min_sep = 2 x 0.4 m body radius) on an open-play tick, sampled after the sim's separation pass. ticks_per_min = open-play ticks with at least one overlapping pair of the class / open-play minutes. 'any' and 'opponent' are match-level and identical in the home and away maps; 'teammate' is the side's own pairs, so match any = home teammate + away teammate + opponent for events.
definitions.collision.correction_vel_corrected_pct /: Same samples restricted to corrected ones (> 0.01 m/s; fixed-point noise is ~1e-7 m/s): % of samples corrected, nearest-rank p50 / p99 of the corrected samples, and the match maximum over all samples. Contact is rare, so the unconditional p50/p95 are ~0 and the conditional ones characterise the push-out itself.
definitions.collision.correction_vel_p50_mps / p95 /: Position-correction velocity per player per consecutive open-play tick pair: |(pos_t - pos_t-1) * 60 - vel_t| in m/s, all on-pitch players incl. GK. vel_t is the published end-of-tick velocity, which the sim integrated (pos += vel * dt) before the separation pass, so with no contact the value is 0 apart from touchline clamps; with contact it is push-out displacement / dt minus the separation pass's own velocity impulse/slip (both act along the contact, so this is a lower bound of the pure push-out speed). Nearest-rank percentiles over the match; pct_gt_0_3 = % of samples above 0.3 m/s (the research report's p99 target).
definitions.coord.cruise_over72_pct: Over outfielder-ticks of eligible players (not the ball carrier, more than 8 m from the ball, and not one of the side's two outfielders closest to the ball, ties by slot): % with speed > 0.72 * top speed. Top speed approximates the sim's step_all_players at full stamina with full sprint throttle and no carrier/jockey/direction penalty: (5.45 + 0.026 * pace) m/s * 1.205 (5v5) or * 1.220 (11v11); stamina, the facing-alignment scale and run boosts are ignored, so a tired player's real top speed is lower than assumed (the metric is a lower bound on violations).
definitions.coord.dual_chaser_ticks_per_min / dual_c: Open-play ticks with ball.owner == None (includes passes and shots in flight) on which >= 2 of this side's on-pitch players (GK included) are within 8 m of the ball (xy) and closing on it at > 1.5 m/s (vel . unit(ball - pos)); per open-play minute, and as % of loose-ball ticks.
definitions.coord.engagers3_ticks_per_min / engagers: Open-play ticks where the opponent owns the ball and >= 3 of this side's outfielders are within 2.5 m of the carrier; per open-play minute, and as % of ticks with an opposing carrier (same denominator as swarm3_pct).
definitions.coord.max_simultaneous_chasers: Maximum number of this side's players meeting the chaser condition on one loose-ball tick.
definitions.final_hashes: MatchSimulation::state_hash() after the final tick, one per seed, hex. Identical hashes on a rerun prove determinism; any sim change will change them.
definitions.general.autopilot: Round 4. --home-controller / --away-controller autopilot sets that side to SideController::Human and, before every tick, feeds it psfc_sim::ai::suggest_cpu_input(sim.state(), side, difficulty) (the side-effect-free CPU input, computed from the state after the previous tick, i.e. one tick of input latency; the other side's frame is idle and ignored). This drives the human-side paths (auto-switch, controlled player, teammate contain) that CPU-vs-CPU never runs. Config ids/labels name such a side 'autopilot-<difficulty>'; CPU-only ids are unchanged. Final hashes are deterministic: the unit test autopilot_match_is_deterministic runs the same autopilot config twice and asserts identical state_hash.
definitions.general.means: mean_home / mean_away are means over seeds; mean_teams is the mean of mean_home and mean_away (for *_max keys this is a mean of per-match maxima).
definitions.general.phase: Per side and open-play tick: 'attacking' if ball.owner is that side, else (ball loose) if ball.last_touch_team is that side; 'defending' if the owner / last toucher is the opponent; ticks with no owner and no last touch are excluded from phase metrics.
definitions.general.sampling: The sim is ticked at 60 Hz with both controllers set to SideController::Cpu(difficulty) and idle external input; MatchState is sampled after every tick. 'Open play' = MatchPhase::OpenPlay. Per-player deltas only use pairs of consecutive open-play ticks with the same footballer in the slot; sent-off players are skipped. Coordinates are metres, x along the pitch, own goal line at x = -attack_sign(second_half_swapped) * pitch_length/2.
definitions.general.support: Round 4. Support metrics are sampled on open-play ticks where an outfielder (slot != 0) of the side is ball.owner (carrier ticks). Open lane to a teammate: no on-pitch opponent (GK included) within 1.5 m of the segment carrier -> teammate. Offside: mirrors the sim's is_player_offside_at_pass: offsides_enabled, teammate (not the GK) past the offside-zone line (halfway in 11v11, +half_length/3 in 5v5 Rush), more than 0.15 m ahead of the ball and more than 0.2 m ahead of the second-last on-pitch opponent (GK included), all along the attacking axis (this is the task's 'ahead of the second-last opponent' rule with the sim's own zone, ball and tolerance conditions, so it matches what the referee would flag). Open option: an outfield teammate 6-30 m from the carrier with an open lane and not offside.
definitions.general.turnover: Round 4. A turnover against side L happens on the open-play tick t0 on which the opponent O becomes ball.owner while the previous open-play owner was a player of L whose last owned tick is at most 120 ticks (2 s) earlier, with no stoppage in between (any non-open-play tick clears the last owner). So the ball goes from L to O directly (tackle, interception of a pass, keeper claim of a shot or cross) or after a loose spell of at most 2 s; a loose ball contested for longer, and restarts (throw-ins, goal kicks, free kicks), are not turnovers. A transition episode for L starts at t0 and ends at the first of: a stoppage, L owning the ball again, or t0 + 15 s. All trans.* metrics are in the losing side's map.
definitions.gk.catches / gk.parries / gk.tips_over: MatchEventType::Save events for this side classified by detail text: 'catches' -> catch, 'tips' -> tip over, anything else -> parry.
definitions.gk.claims_non_save: gk.gathers - gk.catches (possession gains that were not a shot catch: crosses, loose balls, back passes; approximate).
definitions.gk.excursion_mean_s / gk.excursions_gt1s: Excursion = maximal run of consecutive open-play ticks with the GK outside the goal area (ended by re-entering or by open play stopping; one still open at full time is dropped). Mean duration in seconds, and the rate of excursions longer than 1 s per 10 open-play minutes (filters edge flicker out of rush counts).
definitions.gk.gathers: Open-play ticks where ball.owner becomes (side, 0) after not being (side, 0) on the previous open-play tick (any GK gaining possession: catches, claims, picking up loose balls).
definitions.gk.goals_conceded_gk_gt3m_off_line: Conceded goals where the GK's distance from his own goal line at the tick of the scoring side's last Shot event (within 10 s before the goal) was > 3 m.
definitions.gk.goals_conceded_no_shot_found: Conceded goals with no Shot event by the scoring side in the preceding 10 s (own goals, deflections); excluded from the line-distance check.
definitions.gk.line_dist_at_conceded_shot_mean_m: Mean GK line distance at the attributed shot tick over conceded goals with a shot found.
definitions.gk.line_dist_mean_m / gk.line_dist_max_m: GK distance |gk.x - own_goal_x| in metres over open-play ticks (mean / max).
definitions.gk.pct_outside_6yd: % of open-play ticks where the GK (slot 0) is outside the goal area: depth from own goal line > 5.5 m OR |y| > goal_width/2 + 5.5 m. Same FIFA goal-area geometry for 5v5 and 11v11 (MatchFormat has no goal-area field).
definitions.gk.pct_outside_box: % of open-play ticks where the GK is outside the penalty area: depth > penalty_box_depth OR |y| > penalty_box_width/2 (from MatchFormat).
definitions.gk.rush_count / gk.rush_per_10min: Rush event = open-play tick where the GK was inside the goal area on the previous open-play tick, is outside it now, and dot(gk.vel, ball.xy - gk.pos) > 0 (moving toward the ball). Per 10 min = count * 10 / open-play minutes.
definitions.gk.saves: PlayerMatchStats.saves of the GK slot's footballer.
definitions.gk.scenario_switches_per_10min / gk.scen: Only present when a GK scenario field exists in the public state: the first serde key of the GK PlayerState (then of MatchState; per-side arrays indexed by side) containing 'scenario', 'gk_mode', 'keeper_mode' or equal to 'gk_state'. Switches = open-play ticks where the serialized value differs from the previous sample (MatchState fields are sampled every 30 ticks). seed reports also list ticks per value.
definitions.match(meta).open_play_pct_of_ticks: Open-play ticks as % of all simulated ticks (includes kick-offs, set pieces, celebrations, half time).
definitions.match.offsides: Count of MatchEventType::Offside events whose team is this side (the offending side).
definitions.match.possession_pct: 100 * possession_ticks[side] / (possession_ticks[home] + possession_ticks[away]) as kept by the sim.
definitions.match.shots: Sum of PlayerMatchStats.shots over all players who appeared (starters + subs).
definitions.match.shots_on_target: Sum of PlayerMatchStats.shots_on_target (the sim rolls this back on blocks/woodwork misses).
definitions.move.accel_from_pos_mean_mps2: Same as accel_mean_mps2 but from the second difference of positions over three consecutive open-play ticks (|(p_t - p_t-1) - (p_t-1 - p_t-2)| * 3600): what the renderer actually sees, independent of the vel field.
definitions.move.accel_gt10_pct: % of those player-tick pairs with |vel_t - vel_t-1| * 60 > 10 m/s^2 (roughly above a sprinter's peak acceleration).
definitions.move.accel_mean_mps2: Mean |vel_t - vel_t-1| * 60 over all consecutive open-play player-tick pairs (m/s^2).
definitions.move.class_time_pct.<c>: % of consecutive open-play player-tick pairs whose current tick has move_priority c (the exposure behind the per-class rates).
definitions.move.dspeed_max_mps_per_tick: Max ||vel_t| - |vel_t-1|| over the match (m/s per tick).
definitions.move.heading_change_p95_deg_per_tick_gt3: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the per-tick heading change |angle(vel_t-1, vel_t)| in degrees, over player-tick pairs with speed > 3 m/s on both ticks.
definitions.move.heading_change_pct.<bucket>: Per player per consecutive open-play tick pair with speed > 1 m/s on both ticks: |angle between vel_t-1 and vel_t| bucketed 0-10, 10-45, 45-90, >90 degrees; % of samples. All on-pitch players incl. GK.
definitions.move.heading_sign_flips_per_player_min: Over the heading-histogram samples (speed > 1 m/s on both ticks): signed heading change theta_t = atan2(cross(vel_t-1, vel_t), dot(vel_t-1, vel_t)) in degrees. A heading sign flip is a sample where |theta_t| > 1 deg and the previous consecutive sample's |theta_t-1| > 1 deg with opposite signs (left-right-left steering wobble, independent of the 0.02 m/s lateral dead band of side flips). Count / player-minutes.
definitions.move.lateral_accel_mean_mps2: Mean |cross(vel_t-1, vel_t)| / |vel_t-1| * 60 over the same samples: velocity change perpendicular to the previous heading (m/s^2).
definitions.move.reversals_per_player_min: Count of those samples with dot(vel_t, vel_t-1) < 0, divided by player-minutes (all consecutive open-play player-ticks / 3600).
definitions.move.side_flips_by_class.<c>_per_player_: Round 4. Side flips (move.side_flips_per_player_min) split by psfc_sim::ai::move_priority(state, side, idx) on the tick of the flip (0 carrier / elected chaser / committed keeper, 1 engager or human-controlled, 2 tactical mover, 3 idle / cruising / yielding; outside a fresh plan everyone but the carrier reads 2). per_player_min = flips in class c / player-minutes spent in class c (all consecutive open-play player-tick pairs whose current tick is in class c); share_pct = % of all the side's flips that occurred in class c.
definitions.move.side_flips_per_player_min: Per player, over the heading-histogram samples (speed > 1 m/s on both ticks): lateral component l_t = cross(vel_t-1, vel_t) / |vel_t-1| (m/s, sign = turning left/right of the previous heading). A side flip is a sample whose l_t and the previous tick's l_t-1 are both above 0.02 m/s in magnitude with opposite signs (avoidance oscillation). Count / player-minutes.
definitions.move.side_flips_speed_lt3_per_player_min: Side flips split by the current tick's speed |vel_t| < 3 m/s or >= 3 m/s, each divided by the player-minutes spent in that speed band.
definitions.move.speed_oscillation_pct: Over three consecutive open-play ticks where both speed changes exceed 0.05 m/s: % where the speed change flips sign (speed up / slow down / speed up sawtooth). A smooth accelerate-cruise-decelerate profile scores near 0.
definitions.move.turn_rate_mean_deg_per_s: Mean of the per-tick heading change (degrees) * 60 over the heading-histogram samples (speed > 1 m/s on both ticks).
definitions.shape.<phase>.anchor_dist_m.<role>: Mean distance in metres between each player and psfc_sim::ai::world_anchor_for_player(state, side, idx, 0) (static formation slot, no shift) by PlayerRole.
definitions.shape.<phase>.anchor_dist_shape_m.<role>: Same for outfielders after subtracting the outfield block's mean x-offset from anchors on that tick: measures loss of shape independent of the whole team pushing up / dropping as a unit.
definitions.shape.<phase>.bbox_area_m2 / bbox_depth_: Axis-aligned bounding box of on-pitch outfielders (GK excluded): depth = x-extent, width = y-extent, area = depth * width.
definitions.shape.<phase>.length_m / width_m / stret: Round 3 team shape over on-pitch outfielders (GK excluded): length = x extent, width = y extent (same numbers as bbox_depth_m / bbox_width_m, named after the literature), stretch index = mean distance of outfielders to their centroid. Phase attacking = in possession, defending = out of possession (general.phase). Peer-reviewed 11v11 envelope: length 31-46 m, width 35-48 m, stretch 7-16 m; there is no published 5v5 envelope.
definitions.shape.<phase>.nearest_mate_mean_m / near: For every on-pitch outfielder and tick of the phase, distance to the nearest other outfielder of the same side; mean and 10th percentile (nearest rank).
definitions.shape.<phase>.pct_of_open_play: % of the side's open-play ticks classified in that phase.
definitions.shape.defending.line_x_variance_m2 / lin: Population variance (and std dev) of x of the back line while defending. Back line = outfielders with role Defender; if fewer than 2 (5v5 1-2-1 has one), the 2 outfielders with the deepest base_anchor_permille.x.
definitions.shape.defending.pct_outfield_behind_ball: Mean % of the side's outfielders strictly goal-side of the ball ((x - ball.x) * attack_sign < 0) while defending.
definitions.shape.defending.swarm2_pct / swarm3_pct: % of defending ticks where the opponent owns the ball (a carrier exists) with >= 2 (>= 3) of this side's outfielders within 1.6 m of the carrier.
definitions.support.carrier_pct_of_open_play: Carrier ticks as % of the side's open-play ticks (sample size of the support metrics).
definitions.support.cluster_pct: % of carrier ticks where two outfield teammates other than the carrier are within 4 m of each other and both within 15 m of the carrier.
definitions.support.forward_options_mean: Mean number of open options at least 3 m ahead of the carrier along the attacking axis ((x_mate - x_carrier) * attack_sign >= 3).
definitions.support.nearest_option_dist_m: Mean distance carrier -> nearest open option, over carrier ticks with at least one open option.
definitions.support.open_options_mean / open_options: Number of open options per carrier tick: mean, 10th percentile (nearest rank) across carrier ticks, and % of carrier ticks with 0 or 1 open option.
definitions.support.pass_target_open_pct / passes_co: From the event stream plus owner transitions (the sim's Pass event carries no receiver): a MatchEventType::Pass of the side within 2 ticks after its last carrier tick starts a pass by that carrier, remembering which teammates (GK included, no distance band) had an open, non-offside lane on that last carrier tick. The pass is completed when the next open-play owner is a teammate other than the passer; any other next owner, or a stoppage, ends it. pass_target_open_pct = % of completed passes whose receiver had an open lane at the moment of the pass; passes_completed_tracked = their count per match (open-play passes only; Pass events also cover clearances, which count when a teammate collects them; set-piece passes are not tracked).
definitions.support.runs_in_behind_per_10min: Per outfielder other than the owner, on open-play ticks while his side owns the ball (any owner incl. GK), against the line L = second-last opponent's x along the attacking axis on that tick: a run counts when the player was at or behind L on an earlier such tick (armed) and is now ahead of L with |vel| > 5 m/s. After crossing (counted or not) he must drop more than 1 m behind L to be armed again; losing possession or a stoppage disarms everyone. Count per 10 open-play minutes.
definitions.support.width_m / support.depth_m: y-extent / x-extent of the side's on-pitch outfielders (carrier included) on carrier ticks, mean.
definitions.trans.count_per_10min: Turnovers suffered by the side (general.turnover) per 10 open-play minutes.
definitions.trans.counterpress_pct: % of turnovers after which the side owns the ball again within 6 s (t0 + 360 ticks) with no stoppage in between.
definitions.trans.forward_recovery_speed_mps_0_5s /: Over episode ticks t0 .. t0 + 5 s (exclusive) and the side's on-pitch players with PlayerRole::Forward: mean |vel| (m/s), and % of those player-ticks with |vel| > 6 m/s.
definitions.trans.forwards_staying_high_mean: Mean number of the side's on-pitch Forwards ahead of the ball ((x - ball.x) * attack_sign > 0) at t0 + 6 s, over episodes still running then (rest offence kept high).
definitions.trans.in_shape_at_turnover_pct: % of scored time_to_shape episodes (defensive_shape_anchor variant) already in shape on the turnover tick t0 (time 0 s). A high value means the criterion is met by position at the moment of the loss (players already goal-side of the ball), not by a recovery run.
definitions.trans.pct_outfield_behind_ball_at_3s / _: % of the side's on-pitch outfielders strictly goal-side of the ball at exactly t0 + 3 s (180 ticks) and t0 + 6 s (360 ticks), over episodes still running at that tick (no stoppage, not regained).
definitions.trans.time_to_shape_s / time_to_shape_ca: Seconds from t0 to the first episode tick on which at least 80% of the side's on-pitch outfielders are either within 5 m of psfc_sim::ai::defensive_shape_anchor(state, side, idx) (the defensive-block slot the AI is assigned, ball-relative via the team memory's ref_ball; falls back to the static slot for unassigned players) or strictly goal-side of the ball ((x - ball.x) * attack_sign < 0). Episodes reaching 15 s without it score 15 s and count as capped (capped_pct = % of scored episodes). Episodes that end earlier by a stoppage or by the side regaining the ball, before reaching shape, are not scored (excluded_pct = % of all turnovers). The tick t0 itself is checked (0 s = already in shape).
definitions.trans.time_to_shape_static_s /_static_ca: Same with the static formation slot world_anchor_for_player(state, side, idx, 0) instead of defensive_shape_anchor: a reference that does not depend on the AI's own block logic, for before/after comparisons across AI changes.
